acceptance.comparison: v4 is a distinct 8e02 source and executable; stored inputs match exactly; no controlled timing speedup claim
acceptance.conservative_reservations: generic register ledger remains conservative; native array payload is not RSS or total process memory
acceptance.sampling: rank PID RSS/AS sampled every 20 ms; may miss peaks; high-water sums are separate observations
acceptance.source_scope: 9ad source excludes the later whole-node acceptance metadata correction; all actual cases were and remain open
acceptance.strict_capacity: open: 4 MiB stored input is below every 8 GiB rank process cap; whole-node enforcement remains unverified
acceptance.threading: 288 requested threads and native multithreading enabled; actual OpenMP team size unmeasured; producer/loading/matching pair arithmetic/routing remain serial
acceptance.whole_node_enforcement: unverified: rank RLIMIT_AS and sampled rank PIDs exclude allocation coordinator, launchers and external helpers
